    SELECT [f].[UserId], [f].[MangaId]
    FROM [Follow] AS [f]
    WHERE ([f].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [f].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [f].[DeleteDate] IS NULL
    ORDER BY (SELECT 1)
    OFFSET @__p_0 ROWS FETCH NEXT @__p_1 ROWS ONLY
) AS [t]
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT [m].[Id], [m].[LastChapterUpdate], [m].[MangaBackground], [m].[MangaThumbnail], [m].[Name]
    FROM [Manga] AS [m]
    WHERE ([m].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [m].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [m].[DeleteDate] IS NULL
) AS [t0] ON [t].[MangaId] = [t0].[Id]

    SELECT [u].[Id], [u].[DisplayName]
    FROM [Users] AS [u]

) AS [t1] ON [t].[UserId] = [t1].[Id]
